research.edition: international OpenWeather Current Weather, Geocoding, 5-day Forecast, Air Pollution, UV Index, Weather Stations, Weather Maps, and Weather Triggers APIs
research.searchCoverage: Official OpenWeather HTTP API at https://api.openweathermap.org with appid query authentication, Current Weather, 5-day forecast, Geocoding, Air Pollution, UV Index, Weather Stations 3.0, Weather Maps 1.0 tiles at tile.openweathermap.org, and Weather Triggers list, plus Composio OPENWEATHER_API (21 tools). Pinned credential validator uses GET /geo/1.0/direct?q=London&limit=1. No current unresolved customer-account compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck maps to official GET /geo/1.0/direct?q=London&limit=1 used by the pinned credential validator, not a fabricated account endpoint. This consumes one Geocoding call from the free-plan quota.
Uses HTTPS https://api.openweathermap.org rather than the http:// examples in some OpenWeather pages.
Native category is utility rather than Location/Data: Rust CATEGORIES has neither of those buckets; admitted ops are weather and geocoding reads.
Returns raw OpenWeather JSON under data.
q is required. Optional limit is caller-controlled (1-5) matching official Geocoding API.
Returns the raw OpenWeather location array under data rather than the pinned {locations} wrapper.
Requires lat and lon matching origin fixtures and official coordinate guidance. Optional q, id, and zip are forwarded to the built-in geocoder used by Composio GET_CURRENT_WEATHER.
Optional units and lang bind to documented query names. Returns raw OpenWeather JSON under data.
Requires lat and lon matching origin fixtures. Optional q, id, zip, and mode are forwarded to match Composio GET5_DAY_FORECAST.
Returns raw OpenWeather JSON under data.
Requires lat and lon matching official Current Air Pollution API. Returns raw OpenWeather JSON under data.
Official GET /data/2.5/air_pollution/forecast requires lat and lon.
Official GET /data/2.5/air_pollution/history requires lat, lon, start, and end Unix timestamps.
Official GET /geo/1.0/reverse requires lat and lon. Optional limit is 1-5.
Official GET /geo/1.0/zip requires zip as zip,country. Returns a location object under data.
Official GET /data/2.5/find searches cities in a circle around lat/lon. Optional cnt is 1-50.
Composio still exposes the retired UV Index product as GET /data/2.5/uvi. One Call 3.0 uvi fields are not a separate Composio tool.
Official GET /data/2.5/uvi/forecast. Optional cnt is 1-8 days.
Official GET /data/2.5/uvi/history requires start and end Unix timestamps.
Composio layer enum matches Weather Maps 1.0 (clouds_new, temp_new, …) at https://tile.openweathermap.org/map/{layer}/{z}/{x}/{y}.png, not Maps 2.0 op codes.
Optional opacity, palette, fill_bound, scale, fill, color, and format query parameters are forwarded when set. Non-JSON PNG bodies are returned as a string under data.
Official GET /data/3.0/stations lists stations on the account.
Official GET /data/3.0/stations/{id}. Composio station_id is the internal OpenWeather station id.
Official POST /data/3.0/stations returns 201. Body uses external_id, name, latitude, longitude, altitude.
Official PUT /data/3.0/stations/{id}. Composio requires latitude and longitude; name, altitude, and external_id are optional.
Official DELETE /data/3.0/stations/{id} returns 204. Empty bodies map to {success: true}.
Official POST /data/3.0/measurements sends a JSON array and returns 204.
Official GET /data/3.0/measurements requires station_id, type (m|h|d), from, to, and limit.
Composio GET_WEATHER_TRIGGERS retrieves registered triggers. Implemented as official GET /data/3.0/triggers.
Optional triggers array is accepted for Composio-shaped input and is not sent on the list GET.
